classification.difficultyReason: Equate algebraic angle expressions through opposite or corresponding angles and solve with variables on both sides.

content.prompt: Work out value of $x$ in these diagrams.

spec.description: Two intersecting lines, one rising and one gently descending. Opposite left and right sectors carry arcs labelled (2x + 15)° and 3x respectively.
Two gently rising parallel lines cross a steep rising transversal. Each parallel line has one rightward marker. Lower-left sectors are labelled (3x + 22)° above and (5x + 2)° below.

answer.worked:
Corresponding angles on parallel lines are equal.
$$\begin{align*}3x+22&=5x+2\\22&=2x+2\\20&=2x\\x&=10^\circ\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two nearly vertical parallel lines with upward markers below their intersections meet a descending transversal. The upper-left exterior sector at the left intersection is (5x − 12)°; the lower-right exterior sector at the right intersection is (3x + 8)°.
spec.mathematics: Corresponding and vertically opposite angles give 5x − 12 = 3x + 8.

answer.worked:
Corresponding angles on parallel lines and vertically opposite angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}5x-12&=3x+8\\2x-12&=8\\2x&=20\\x&=10^\circ\end{align*}$$
